name: delete_repository
description: DESTRUCTIVE AND IRREVERSIBLE. Permanently deletes a repository and every node and relationship belonging to it from the graph. There is no undo, and recovering the data requires a full re-index, which can take a long time on a large repository. Only call this when the user has explicitly asked for that repository to be removed.

graph_name.description: Optional: Name of the FalkorDB graph to query. Each indexed repository can have its own graph. Use 'list_graphs' to see available graphs. Defaults to the server's configured graph name.

repo_path.description: The path of the repository to delete.
